name: decide-tue12-recorded
what: Larkspur, Tue Mar 12, held by the WAF file: decided in the recorded story (ADR 0021 §6), published as is by the security lead with her reason; the record's decision is applied again here, and the day isn't the visitor's to decide

pageText: The east ingress really was in monitor mode overnight

name: decide-thu28-sheet
what: Thu Mar 28, held by the org chain that loops and the owner chains it feeds, still waiting for the visitor: the decision sheet with Publish as is picked and a reason chosen, before it goes out; Keep names Wed 27, the day readers have, and Replace the file isn't offered, since the held files aren't one file

name: decide-thu28-published
what: Publish as is: one choice for the day, recorded as a decision for each held file and one release citing them (Q-193); the engine publishes the day for itself, and readers stay on Sun 31, the latest day out (Q-51, ADR 0022 §1)

pageText: Published as is · readers stay on Sun 31

name: decide-sat23-kept
what: Sat Mar 23, the DR exercises late, waiting for the visitor: kept back, readers keep Fri 22

name: decide-sun24-fill
what: Sun Mar 24, held by the DR exercises file alone (ADR 0023 §5): the sheet decides that file, its rows drawn against its own history, and offers it filled whole from a good day, none of the day's rows kept, so keeping the last good day stays what is recommended, told by the file's own story (a learned check that moved a third of its rows, Q-132); picked, the fill is staged in the engine, every step built from the file told again of the filled rows

pageText: readers keep the last good day while someone looks

name: decide-sun24-filled
what: The fill decided: one choice recorded as a decision for each held file, released by the decision about the DR exercises file; readers stay on the latest day, and Sun 24 is filled

name: decide-reload
what: After a reload, Thu 28 runs again and its decisions are applied again from the record: still published as is, Sat 23 still kept back and Sun 24 still filled
